There are two bugs describing this issue https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2071123 https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2071951 The second is a duplicate of the first one.

The only temporary solution I know is to delete the guilty session.json file from the profile folder >> find your profile folder by pressing the Windows Key key and then start typing: %APPDATA%\Thunderbird\Profiles\ In folder Profiles you might find one or more profile folders with names like default, default-release, default-esr, .... Try to identify your actual/active profile folder by comparing modification dates of files, then delete the file session.json and close the folder Thunderbird. Restart Thunderbird and avoid opening very many messages and .pdf files in new tabs, until this bug will be fixed.
